name: HEVC + Stash Sync
description: Re-encode to HEVC in an mkv, replace the original, then tell Stash so it can merge the new file onto the original scene and keep tags, markers, o-counter and play history. Edit the Notify Stash node before first use.

flowPlugins.name: Notify Stash  <-- EDIT THE URL + API KEY IN HERE
SETUP: open the 'Notify Stash' node at the bottom and set STASH_URL and STASH_API_KEY. Then set the path map in Stash > Settings > Plugins > Tdarr Sync.
Output 1 means the file is already HEVC, so the flow ends and Stash is never touched. This is what stops Tdarr re-encoding its own output forever.

Band is 20-95%, not the stock 40-110%. 95 because an output LARGER than the input is a pure loss for a space-saving flow. 20 because HEVC off old DivX legitimately lands under 40% and the stock floor would throw those away.

Notify Stash MUST be last. Before 'Replace Original File' runs, args.inputFileObj._id still points at the cache copy, not the file Stash needs to scan. Branches that do not replace the original never get here, which is correct - nothing changed, so there is nothing to sync.
